title: Spicy Portuguese Toast with Kiwifruit
description: A refreshing and spicy twist on traditional toast, perfect for a quick breakfast or snack.
instructions: 1. Preheat a pan or griddle over medium heat.
2. Add butter to the pan and melt.
3. Add slices of chorizo and cook until browned and crispy.
4. Meanwhile, toast slices of bread until lightly browned.
5. Slice the kiwi into thin pieces.
6. Assemble the toast by spreading a slice of bread with a piece of chorizo, then topping with a slice of kiwi, a drizzle of honey, and a few fresh mint leaves.
8. Optional: Add a sprinkle of red pepper flakes on top for extra heat.
